MasonryGridView.doc: A scrollable, 2D array of widgets placed according to the masonry layout.

scrollDirection.doc: The [Axis] along which the scroll view's offset increases.

reverse.doc: Whether the scroll view scrolls in the reading direction.

controller.doc:
An object that can be used to control the position to which this scroll
view is scrolled.

primary.doc:
Whether this is the primary scroll view associated with the parent
[PrimaryScrollController].

physics.doc: How the scroll view should respond to user input.

shrinkWrap.doc:
Whether the extent of the scroll view in the [scrollDirection] should be
determined by the contents being viewed.

padding.doc: The amount of space by which to inset the children.

gridDelegate.doc:
A delegate that controls the layout of the children within the
[MasonryGridView].

semanticChildCount.doc: The number of children that will contribute semantic information.

keyboardDismissBehavior.doc:
The [ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior] defines how this [ScrollView] will
dismiss the keyboard automatically.

StaggeredGridCount.doc:
A grid which lays out children in a staggered arrangement.
Each child can have a different size.
Wrap your children with a [StaggeredGridTile] to specify their size if it's
different from a 1x1 tile.

StaggeredGridExtent.doc:
A grid which lays out children in a staggered arrangement.
Each child can have a different size.
Wrap your children with a [StaggeredGridTile] to specify their size if it's
different from a 1x1 tile.

StaggeredGridTileCount.doc: Represents the size of a [StaggeredGrid]'s tile.

crossAxisCellCount.doc: The number of cells that this tile takes along the cross axis.

mainAxisCellCount.doc: The number of cells that this tile takes along the main axis.

StaggeredGridTileExtent.doc: Represents the size of a [StaggeredGrid]'s tile.

crossAxisCellCount.doc: The number of cells that this tile takes along the cross axis.

mainAxisExtent.doc: The amount of space that this tile takes along the main axis.

StaggeredGridTileFit.doc: Represents the size of a [StaggeredGrid]'s tile.

crossAxisCellCount.doc: The number of cells that this tile takes along the cross axis.

Axis.doc: The two cardinal directions in two dimensions.

AxisDirection.doc:
A direction along either the horizontal or vertical [Axis] in which the
origin, or zero position, is determined.

ScrollDecelerationRate.doc: The rate at which scroll momentum will be decelerated.

ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.doc:
A representation of how a [ScrollView] should dismiss the on-screen
keyboard.

EdgeInsetsGeometry.doc:
Base class for [EdgeInsets] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

ScrollPhysics.doc: Determines the physics of a [Scrollable] widget.

SliverSimpleGridDelegate.doc: Controls the layout of tiles in a some slivers.

ViewPadding.doc:
A representation of distances for each of the four edges of a rectangle,
used to encode the view insets and padding that applications should place
around their user interface, as exposed by [FlutterView.viewInsets] and
[FlutterView.padding]. View insets and padding are preferably read via
[MediaQuery.of].
